name: VHELM
description: VHELM is a holistic evaluation framework for vision-language models that aggregates multiple datasets to assess nine aspects including visual perception, knowledge, reasoning, bias, fairness, multilinguality, robustness, toxicity, and safety. It standardizes inference parameters, prompting methods, and evaluation metrics to enable fair and comprehensive comparisons across models.
reputation: Intended as a living benchmark with ongoing dataset and model additions; provides a comprehensive multi-dimensional view of VLM capabilities.
notes: Covers 21 existing datasets and evaluates 22 VLMs; designed to be lightweight and automatic for fast evaluation.
